flows.title: Create a repository
steps: From Bitbucket, select the Create button and then select Repository. Bitbucket shows the Create a new repository page.
Enter a name in the Name field. Bitbucket uses this name in the repository's address.
Everything on this page except the Repository type can be changed later.
The repository starts empty. It is the central repository for the files, and other people reach it only if they are given permission.
